title: EC2 -Q&A
body:
📘 CATEGORY 1: INSTANCE TYPES (Q1–Q10)

Q1. A company is running a SAP HANA database requiring 24 TB of RAM. Which EC2 instance family should be used?

  • A) R5
  • B) C5
  • C) X1e / X2iedn ✅
  • D) M5

💡 Explanation: X-family is designed for extreme memory workloads like SAP HANA. 🎯 Trigger: "SAP HANA" → X-family

Q2. Which instance family provides the best price-performance for Linux workloads that can be recompiled for ARM?

  • A) M5
  • B) M6g (Graviton) ✅
  • C) C5
  • D) T3

💡 Explanation: Graviton (ARM) offers up to 40% better price/performance. 🎯 Trigger: "Best price-performance" → Graviton (g-suffix)

Q3. A gaming company needs a server for CPU-intensive game physics simulations. Which family?

  • A) R5
  • B) C5 ✅
  • C) T3
  • D) I3

💡 Explanation: C-family = Compute Optimized. 🎯 Trigger: "CPU-intensive" → C-family

Q4. A startup runs a development blog with low traffic and occasional bursts. Which instance?

  • A) C5
  • B) T3 ✅
  • C) M5
  • D) R5

💡 Explanation: T-family is burstable — cheap baseline + CPU credits. 🎯 Trigger: "Bursty, low traffic" → T-family

Q5. A data science team needs to train deep learning models with GPUs. Which family?

  • A) P4d ✅
  • B) G4
  • C) Inf1
  • D) C5

💡 Explanation: P = training, G = graphics/inference.

Q6. A team runs a Cassandra NoSQL cluster needing ultra-low latency local storage. Which family?

  • A) D2
  • B) I3 ✅
  • C) R5
  • D) C5

💡 Explanation: I-family has local NVMe SSDs. 🎯 Trigger: "High IOPS, NoSQL" → I-family

Q7. You run an in-memory Redis cache needing 128 GB RAM. Best family?

  • A) R5 ✅
  • B) C5
  • C) T3
  • D) M5

🎯 Trigger: "In-memory DB, Redis" → R-family

Q8. A company runs Hadoop clusters processing petabytes of data. Best family?

  • A) I3
  • B) D3 ✅
  • C) R5
  • D) X1

🎯 Trigger: "Hadoop, data warehouse" → D-family

Q9. Which instance family is cheapest for ML inference at scale?

  • A) P4
  • B) G4
  • C) Inf1 / Inf2 ✅
  • D) C5

🎯 Trigger: "ML inference at low cost" → Inf-family

Q10. T3 instance runs out of CPU credits. What happens in T3 Standard mode?

  • A) Instance terminates
  • B) CPU throttled to baseline ✅
  • C) Automatically upgrades
  • D) You pay extra

💡 Explanation: T3 Standard throttles; T3 Unlimited charges extra.

📘 CATEGORY 2: PRICING MODELS (Q11–Q25)

Q11. A nightly batch job can be retried if interrupted. Cheapest option?

  • A) On-Demand
  • B) Reserved Instance
  • C) Spot ✅
  • D) Dedicated Host

🎯 Trigger: "Fault-tolerant, interruptible" → Spot (90% off)

Q12. A bank's production DB runs 24/7 for the next 3 years. Best pricing?

  • A) On-Demand
  • B) Spot
  • C) Reserved Instance (Standard, 3-year) ✅
  • D) Capacity Reservation

🎯 Trigger: "24/7 steady-state" → Standard RI

Q13. A company uses EC2, Lambda, and Fargate. Wants one discount covering all. Which?

  • A) Reserved Instance
  • B) EC2 Instance Savings Plan
  • C) Compute Savings Plan ✅
  • D) Spot

💡 Explanation: Only Compute Savings Plan covers EC2 + Lambda + Fargate.

Q14. Oracle DB requiring per-socket licensing audit. Which?

  • A) Dedicated Instance
  • B) Dedicated Host ✅
  • C) Reserved Instance
  • D) On-Demand

🎯 Trigger: "BYOL, per-socket" → Dedicated Host

Q15. A company may change instance family (M5 → C5) during the 3-year commitment. Which?

  • A) Standard RI
  • B) Convertible RI ✅
  • C) Savings Plan
  • D) Spot

💡 Explanation: Convertible RI allows family changes.

Q16. A retailer wants guaranteed capacity in us-east-1a during Black Friday but no discount needed. Which?

  • A) Reserved Instance
  • B) On-Demand Capacity Reservation ✅
  • C) Spot
  • D) Savings Plan

🎯 Trigger: "Guarantee capacity, no discount" → Capacity Reservation

Q17. Which is TRUE about Spot instances?

  • A) Never interrupted
  • B) Up to 90% discount, 2-min warning ✅
  • C) Requires 1-year commitment
  • D) Same price as On-Demand

Q18. A Spot instance is interrupted and you want to keep EBS data and resume later. Set interruption behavior to?

  • A) Terminate
  • B) Stop or Hibernate ✅
  • C) Reboot
  • D) Restart

Q19. Savings Plan does NOT cover:

  • A) EC2 On-Demand
  • B) Fargate
  • C) Lambda
  • D) Spot Instances ✅

💡 Explanation: Spot + Dedicated Host excluded.

Q20. What's the difference between Dedicated Host and Dedicated Instance?

💡 Answer:

  • Dedicated Host = see sockets/cores (BYOL)
  • Dedicated Instance = hardware isolation only (no visibility)

Q21. Which RI type gives capacity reservation?

  • A) Regional RI
  • B) Zonal RI ✅
  • C) Convertible RI
  • D) Savings Plan

Q22. Customer wants to sell unused Standard RIs. Where?

  • A) eBay
  • B) RI Marketplace ✅
  • C) AWS Marketplace
  • D) Not possible

Q23. Which Spot allocation strategy minimizes interruptions?

  • A) lowestPrice
  • B) capacityOptimized ✅
  • C) diversified
  • D) mostExpensive

Q24. A workload uses On-Demand + Spot. Which feature?

  • A) Capacity Reservation
  • B) Mixed Instances Policy (in ASG) ✅
  • C) Savings Plan
  • D) Convertible RI

Q25. A company wants right-sizing recommendations based on actual usage. Which tool?

  • A) Cost Explorer
  • B) AWS Compute Optimizer ✅
  • C) Trusted Advisor
  • D) CloudWatch

💡 Explanation: Compute Optimizer uses 14 days of CloudWatch data.

📘 CATEGORY 3: STORAGE – EBS (Q26–Q40)

Q26. A database needs 200,000 IOPS. Which EBS type?

  • A) gp3
  • B) io1
  • C) io2 Block Express ✅
  • D) st1

💡 Explanation: io2 Block Express = up to 256,000 IOPS.

Q27. You want to move an EBS volume to another AZ. Steps?

💡 Answer:

  1. Take snapshot
  2. Create volume from snapshot in target AZ
  3. Attach to EC2 in new AZ

Q28. Which EBS type is cheapest HDD?

  • A) st1
  • B) sc1 ✅
  • C) gp2
  • D) io1

Q29. You stopped an EC2. What happens?

  • A) All data lost
  • B) EBS kept, Instance Store LOST ✅
  • C) Both kept
  • D) Both lost

Q30. Can EBS volumes be attached to multiple EC2s simultaneously?

  • A) Yes, any volume
  • B) Only io1/io2 Multi-Attach, same AZ, max 16 Nitro instances ✅
  • C) Only gp3
  • D) No

Q31. EBS snapshots are stored in:

  • A) Your S3 bucket
  • B) S3 (managed by AWS, not visible) ✅
  • C) EBS itself
  • D) Glacier

Q32. Fastest way to get immediate full performance when restoring large EBS from snapshot?

  • A) Use gp3
  • B) Enable Fast Snapshot Restore (FSR) ✅
  • C) Use io2
  • D) Pre-warm manually

Q33. Can you shrink an EBS volume?

  • A) Yes
  • B) No — only grow ✅
  • C) Only gp3
  • D) Only via snapshot

Q34. How to encrypt an unencrypted EBS volume?

💡 Answer: Snapshot → copy with encryption → restore new volume.

Q35. Which tool automates EBS snapshot lifecycle?

  • A) CloudWatch
  • B) Data Lifecycle Manager (DLM) ✅
  • C) Backup Vault
  • D) AWS Backup only

Q36. Which snapshot tier is 75% cheaper for long-term retention?

  • A) Standard
  • B) Archive ✅
  • C) Glacier
  • D) IA

💡 Explanation: Archive tier — minimum 90 days, 24–72h restore.

Q37. Recover accidentally deleted EBS snapshot?

  • A) Not possible
  • B) Recycle Bin ✅
  • C) CloudTrail
  • D) Backup Vault

Q38. By default, when EC2 is terminated:

  • A) Root EBS kept
  • B) Root EBS deleted (DeleteOnTermination=true) ✅
  • C) All EBS kept
  • D) Instance Store kept

Q39. Max RAID for highest IOPS on EBS?

  • A) RAID 1
  • B) RAID 5
  • C) RAID 0 ✅
  • D) RAID 6

Q40. You resize an EBS from 100 GB → 500 GB. What's next?

  • A) Nothing
  • B) Extend the file system (resize2fs / xfs_growfs) ✅
  • C) Reboot instance
  • D) Create new volume

📘 CATEGORY 4: STORAGE – EFS, FSx, Instance Store (Q41–Q50)

Q41. A fleet of 10 Linux EC2s across 3 AZs needs shared file storage. Which?

  • A) EBS
  • B) EFS ✅
  • C) Instance Store
  • D) S3

Q42. A Windows file share with AD integration is needed. Which?

  • A) EFS
  • B) FSx for Windows ✅
  • C) FSx for Lustre
  • D) EBS

Q43. HPC ML training needs sub-ms latency file system. Which?

  • A) EFS
  • B) FSx for Windows
  • C) FSx for Lustre ✅
  • D) EBS

Q44. Instance Store data is lost when?

  • A) Reboot
  • B) Stop, Hibernate, Terminate, hardware failure ✅
  • C) Only terminate
  • D) Never

Q45. Which storage is fastest for temporary cache?

  • A) EBS gp3
  • B) EFS
  • C) Instance Store ✅
  • D) sc1

Q46. EFS supports which OS?

  • A) Windows only
  • B) Linux only ✅
  • C) Both
  • D) macOS

Q47. An app must migrate NetApp workloads from on-prem. Which?

  • A) EFS
  • B) FSx for NetApp ONTAP ✅
  • C) FSx for Windows
  • D) EBS

Q48. EFS storage classes include:

  • A) Standard only
  • B) Standard, IA, One Zone ✅
  • C) Standard, Glacier
  • D) Hot, Cool, Cold

Q49. Which is TRUE about EFS?

  • A) Single AZ
  • B) Multi-AZ, regional ✅
  • C) Block storage
  • D) Windows SMB

Q50. EFS uses which protocol?

  • A) SMB
  • B) NFSv4 ✅
  • C) iSCSI
  • D) Lustre

📘 CATEGORY 5: SECURITY (Q51–Q60)

Q51. Which firewall is stateful and supports allow-only rules?

  • A) NACL
  • B) Security Group ✅
  • C) WAF
  • D) Route Table

Q52. How to block a specific IP from your entire subnet?

  • A) Security Group deny rule
  • B) NACL deny rule ✅
  • C) Route table
  • D) IAM policy

💡 Explanation: SG can't deny; NACL supports deny rules.

Q53. EC2 needs to access S3. Best practice?

  • A) Store access keys on EC2
  • B) Attach IAM Role (Instance Profile) ✅
  • C) Use root credentials
  • D) Hard-code in app

Q54. Which IMDS version is more secure?

  • A) IMDSv1
  • B) IMDSv2 (token-based, prevents SSRF) ✅
  • C) Both same
  • D) IMDSv3

Q55. You need SSH-like access to private EC2 with no port 22 open and audit logs. Use?

  • A) Bastion host
  • B) VPN
  • C) Systems Manager Session Manager ✅
  • D) Direct SSH

Q56. The IMDS endpoint URL is?

  • A) 10.0.0.1
  • B) 169.254.169.254 ✅
  • C) 127.0.0.1
  • D) 172.16.0.1

Q57. Which prevents accidental EC2 termination?

  • A) IAM policy only
  • B) Termination Protection ✅
  • C) Delete on Termination
  • D) CloudTrail

Q58. You want to process highly sensitive data in isolated CPU/memory. Use?

  • A) Dedicated Instance
  • B) Nitro Enclaves ✅
  • C) Dedicated Host
  • D) Session Manager

Q59. By default, a new Security Group:

  • A) Allows all inbound
  • B) Denies all inbound, allows all outbound ✅
  • C) Denies everything
  • D) Allows everything

Q60. EC2 Instance Connect works by:

  • A) Opening permanent SSH
  • B) Pushing temporary SSH key via API (60s validity) ✅
  • C) Using VPN
  • D) Using S3 key

📘 CATEGORY 6: LOAD BALANCERS (Q61–Q72)

Q61. Customer firewall needs to whitelist LB IP. Which?

  • A) ALB
  • B) NLB (static IP per AZ) ✅
  • C) CLB
  • D) GLB

Q62. Which LB supports path-based routing?

  • A) NLB
  • B) ALB ✅
  • C) GLB
  • D) CLB

Q63. Which LB handles UDP traffic?

  • A) ALB
  • B) NLB ✅
  • C) GLB
  • D) CLB

Q64. Which LB supports Lambda as target?

  • A) NLB
  • B) ALB ✅
  • C) GLB
  • D) CLB

Q65. Which LB is used for inserting 3rd-party firewalls (Palo Alto)?

  • A) ALB
  • B) NLB
  • C) GLB ✅
  • D) CLB

Q66. Cross-Zone Load Balancing is FREE on which LB?

  • A) NLB
  • B) ALB ✅
  • C) Both free
  • D) Both paid

💡 Explanation: NLB cross-zone is paid (data transfer).

Q67. How does ALB preserve client IP?

  • A) Natively
  • B) Via X-Forwarded-For header ✅
  • C) Not possible
  • D) Via TCP

💡 Explanation: NLB preserves natively.

Q68. ALB sticky session cookie is called?

  • A) JSESSIONID
  • B) AWSALB ✅
  • C) SESSION
  • D) LB-cookie

Q69. You want in-flight requests to complete before ALB removes instance. Use?

  • A) Cooldown
  • B) Deregistration Delay ✅
  • C) Warm-up
  • D) Grace period

💡 Default: 300 seconds.

Q70. Which LB offers lowest latency (~100 μs)?

  • A) ALB
  • B) NLB ✅
  • C) GLB
  • D) CLB

Q71. ALB supports which target types?

  • A) Instance only
  • B) Instance, IP, Lambda, ALB ✅
  • C) IP only
  • D) Lambda only

Q72. Multiple SSL certificates on one ALB use?

  • A) Multi-cert
  • B) SNI (Server Name Indication) ✅
  • C) Multi-SAN
  • D) Wildcard only

📘 CATEGORY 7: AUTO SCALING (Q73–Q82)

Q73. Simplest ASG scaling policy?

  • A) Simple
  • B) Step
  • C) Target Tracking ✅
  • D) Predictive

Q74. ASG needs to pre-scale before 9 AM rush. Which policy?

  • A) Target Tracking
  • B) Step
  • C) Scheduled ✅
  • D) Simple

Q75. ASG uses ML to forecast traffic. Which policy?

  • A) Step
  • B) Predictive ✅
  • C) Target Tracking
  • D) Manual

Q76. ASG is:

  • A) $50/month
  • B) FREE (pay only EC2) ✅
  • C) Pay per scaling
  • D) Pay per instance-hour

Q77. New ASG instance takes 5 min to start. Solution?

  • A) Cooldown
  • B) Increase Instance Warm-up + Health Check Grace Period ✅
  • C) Use Spot
  • D) Add more AZs

Q78. Pre-initialized stopped instances ready for fast scale-out?

  • A) Mixed Instances
  • B) Warm Pool ✅
  • C) Cooldown
  • D) Grace period

Q79. ASG launch template is preferred over:

  • A) AMI
  • B) Launch Configuration (legacy) ✅
  • C) User Data
  • D) CloudFormation

Q80. Run a script before instance serves traffic in ASG?

  • A) User Data
  • B) Lifecycle Hook (pending:wait) ✅
  • C) Systems Manager
  • D) CloudWatch Event

Q81. Default ASG termination policy?

  • A) Oldest
  • B) Balance across AZs → oldest launch config → closest to billing hour ✅
  • C) Random
  • D) Newest

Q82. Protect a specific instance from ASG scale-in?

  • A) Tag it
  • B) Instance Scale-in Protection ✅
  • C) Termination Protection
  • D) Stop Protection

📘 CATEGORY 8: PLACEMENT GROUPS (Q83–Q87)

Q83. HPC workload needing lowest latency. Which PG?

  • A) Spread
  • B) Partition
  • C) Cluster ✅
  • D) None

Q84. 5 critical domain controllers — max hardware isolation?

  • A) Cluster
  • B) Spread ✅
  • C) Partition
  • D) None

Q85. Cassandra/Kafka cluster with rack-level isolation?

  • A) Cluster
  • B) Spread
  • C) Partition ✅
  • D) None

Q86. Max instances per AZ in Spread PG?

  • A) 5
  • B) 7 ✅
  • C) 10
  • D) Unlimited

Q87. HPC + MPI/NCCL + lowest latency — combine?

  • A) Spread PG + EFA
  • B) Cluster PG + EFA ✅
  • C) Partition PG + ENI
  • D) No PG + ENA

📘 CATEGORY 9: NETWORKING (Q88–Q93)

Q88. EC2 public IP changes on stop/start. Solution for fixed IP?

  • A) Private IP
  • B) Elastic IP ✅
  • C) Public DNS
  • D) NAT

Q89. Unused Elastic IP:

  • A) Free
  • B) Charged hourly ✅
  • C) Deleted automatically
  • D) Auto-attached

Q90. Which is a virtual NIC that can be detached/re-attached?

  • A) ENA
  • B) EFA
  • C) ENI ✅
  • D) VPC

Q91. HPC workload needs OS-bypass networking. Use?

  • A) ENI
  • B) ENA
  • C) EFA ✅
  • D) VPC Peering

Q92. NAT Gateway HA is achieved by:

  • A) One in each region
  • B) One per AZ ✅
  • C) Auto-redundant
  • D) Not needed

Q93. ENA provides:

  • A) OS-bypass
  • B) Enhanced networking up to 100 Gbps ✅
  • C) Static IP
  • D) HPC support

📘 CATEGORY 10: LIFECYCLE & MONITORING (Q94–Q100)

Q94. To monitor RAM usage on EC2:

  • A) Default metric
  • B) Install CloudWatch Agent ✅
  • C) CloudTrail
  • D) Not possible

Q95. System Status Check fails. Action?

  • A) Fix OS
  • B) Stop/Start (moves to new host) ✅
  • C) Reboot
  • D) Terminate

Q96. Preserve RAM state and pause overnight?

  • A) Stop
  • B) Hibernate ✅
  • C) Reboot
  • D) Terminate

Q97. Hibernation requirements?

  • A) Any instance
  • B) Nitro + encrypted EBS root + RAM ≤ 150 GB ✅
  • C) Any Windows
  • D) Spot only

Q98. Which CloudWatch metric is NOT default?

  • A) CPU
  • B) Network In
  • C) Memory (RAM) ✅
  • D) Disk I/O

Q99. Cheapest DR with high RTO?

  • A) Multi-Site
  • B) Warm Standby
  • C) Pilot Light
  • D) Backup & Restore ✅

Q100. Lowest RTO/RPO DR strategy?

  • A) Backup & Restore
  • B) Pilot Light
  • C) Warm Standby
  • D) Multi-Site Active/Active ✅

🎯 BONUS: TOP 10 SCENARIO-BASED QUESTIONS

B1. A fleet of 50 EC2s handles web traffic. During nightly batch windows, 30 more are launched for 2 hours. Most cost-effective? → 50 Reserved Instances (baseline) + 30 Spot Instances (batch) via ASG Mixed Instances Policy ✅

B2. A customer migrated 200 VMs to EC2. Weekly patched golden AMIs must be distributed across 5 accounts. → EC2 Image Builder + AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) ✅

B3. An ML team trains GPT-scale models on 64 × p4d instances needing NCCL communication. → EFA + Cluster Placement Group + same AZ ✅

B4. Compliance requires no inbound SSH, all sessions logged, MFA enforced. → Systems Manager Session Manager + IAM with MFA ✅

B5. A retailer runs a flash sale at 12 PM daily. Auto Scaling must handle 10× spike in seconds. → ASG + Warm Pool + Scheduled Scaling + Target Tracking ✅

B6. A legacy ERP is licensed to a specific MAC address. HA requirement: move workload to standby in same AZ on failure. → Detach ENI from primary → attach to standby (MAC + IP moves) ✅

B7. A DB must survive AZ failure with near-zero RPO. → Multi-AZ RDS or EBS snapshots + cross-AZ replication + Multi-Site DR ✅

B8. ALB-based blue/green deployment — switch traffic without dropping in-flight requests. → Target Group weighted routing + Deregistration Delay ✅

B9. A static website launched on a single EC2 loses public IP after reboot. → Associate Elastic IP OR use ALB + Route 53 ✅

B10. Development environment EC2s are terminated nightly to save cost but data must persist. → Set DeleteOnTermination=false for data volumes OR use Stop instead of Terminate ✅

🏆 100 MCQs COMPLETE + 10 SCENARIOS!

📊 Exam Strategy Tips

  1. Read keywords first → HPC, SAP HANA, UDP, BYOL → auto-pick
  2. Eliminate obvious wrong → Watch for legacy (CLB, Launch Configuration)
  3. "Cheapest" vs "Best Performance" → different answers!
  4. "Interruption tolerated" → always Spot
  5. "Static IP" → NLB or EIP
  6. "Multi-AZ shared file system" → EFS
  7. "BYOL license" → Dedicated Host
  8. "Per-socket visibility" → Dedicated Host

A) Default metric
B) Install CloudWatch Agent ✅
C) CloudTrail
D) Not possible

A) Fix OS
B) Stop/Start (moves to new host) ✅
C) Reboot
D) Terminate

A) Stop
B) Hibernate ✅
C) Reboot
D) Terminate

A) Any instance
B) Nitro + encrypted EBS root + RAM ≤ 150 GB ✅
C) Any Windows
D) Spot only

Q98. Which CloudWatch metric is NOT default?

A) CPU
B) Network In
C) Memory (RAM) ✅
D) Disk I/O

Q99. Cheapest DR with high RTO?

A) Multi-Site
B) Warm Standby
C) Pilot Light
D) Backup & Restore ✅

Q100. Lowest RTO/RPO DR strategy?

A) Backup & Restore
B) Pilot Light
C) Warm Standby
D) Multi-Site Active/Active ✅
🎯 BONUS: TOP 10 SCENARIO-BASED QUESTIONS

B1. A fleet of 50 EC2s handles web traffic. During nightly batch windows, 30 more are launched for 2 hours. Most cost-effective? → 50 Reserved Instances (baseline) + 30 Spot Instances (batch) via ASG Mixed Instances Policy ✅



B2. A customer migrated 200 VMs to EC2. Weekly patched golden AMIs must be distributed across 5 accounts. → EC2 Image Builder + AWS Resource Access Manager (RAM) ✅



B3. An ML team trains GPT-scale models on 64 × p4d instances needing NCCL communication. → EFA + Cluster Placement Group + same AZ ✅



B4. Compliance requires no inbound SSH, all sessions logged, MFA enforced. → Systems Manager Session Manager + IAM with MFA ✅



B5. A retailer runs a flash sale at 12 PM daily. Auto Scaling must handle 10× spike in seconds. → ASG + Warm Pool + Scheduled Scaling + Target Tracking ✅



B6. A legacy ERP is licensed to a specific MAC address. HA requirement: move workload to standby in same AZ on failure. → Detach ENI from primary → attach to standby (MAC + IP moves) ✅



B7. A DB must survive AZ failure with near-zero RPO. → Multi-AZ RDS or EBS snapshots + cross-AZ replication + Multi-Site DR ✅



B8. ALB-based blue/green deployment — switch traffic without dropping in-flight requests. → Target Group weighted routing + Deregistration Delay ✅



B9. A static website launched on a single EC2 loses public IP after reboot. → Associate Elastic IP OR use ALB + Route 53 ✅



B10. Development environment EC2s are terminated nightly to save cost but data must persist. → Set DeleteOnTermination=false for data volumes OR use Stop instead of Terminate ✅



🏆 100 MCQs COMPLETE + 10 SCENARIOS!
📊 Exam Strategy Tips
Read keywords first → HPC, SAP HANA, UDP, BYOL → auto-pick
Eliminate obvious wrong → Watch for legacy (CLB, Launch Configuration)
"Cheapest" vs "Best Performance" → different answers!
"Interruption tolerated" → always Spot
"Static IP" → NLB or EIP
"Multi-AZ shared file system" → EFS
"BYOL license" → Dedicated Host
"Per-socket visibility" → Dedicated Host

📚 PART 2: DETAILED CONTENT

🟢 TOPIC 1: EC2 BASICS

📋 What to Learn

ConceptKey Point
What is EC2?Virtual servers (IaaS) in AWS
Service modelIaaS — you manage OS + apps
BillingPer-second (Linux), per-hour (some Windows)
Global reachRegion → AZ → Instance

📖 Content

EC2 = Elastic Compute Cloud = Rent virtual servers on AWS.

  • You choose: OS, CPU, RAM, storage, network
  • You manage: OS patches, apps, security
  • AWS manages: hardware, hypervisor, data center

🎯 Exam Tip: EC2 is IaaS, not PaaS/SaaS.

🔴 TOPIC 2: INSTANCE TYPES

📋 What to Learn

FamilyTypeExam Keyword
TBurstable GeneralLow traffic, bursty, dev/test
MGeneral PurposeBalanced workload
CCompute OptimizedCPU-intensive, HPC, batch
RMemory OptimizedIn-memory DB, Redis
XExtreme MemorySAP HANA, massive RAM
IStorage (NVMe SSD)High IOPS, NoSQL
DStorage (HDD)Hadoop, data warehouse
PGPU – TrainingML training, deep learning
GGPU – GraphicsVideo, rendering, gaming
InfInferenceML inference
TrnTrainingCost-effective ML training
g (suffix)Graviton ARMBest price/performance

📖 Content

🔸 T-Family (Burstable)

  • Baseline CPU + CPU credits for bursts
  • T3 Standard = throttle when credits run out
  • T3 Unlimited = pay extra to keep bursting
  • Use: Dev/test, small blogs, low-traffic APIs

🔸 M-Family (General Purpose)

  • Balanced CPU:memory ratio
  • Use: Web apps, small DBs, enterprise apps

🔸 C-Family (Compute Optimized)

  • High CPU, less RAM
  • Use: Batch processing, video encoding, gaming servers, HPC, scientific computing

🔸 R-Family (Memory Optimized)

  • High RAM
  • Use: Redis, Memcached, Elasticsearch, large DBs

🔸 X-Family (Extreme Memory)

  • Up to 24 TB RAM
  • Use: SAP HANA, massive in-memory databases

🔸 I-Family (NVMe Storage)

  • Local SSDs, ultra-high IOPS
  • Use: Cassandra, MongoDB, NoSQL, transactional DBs

🔸 D-Family (HDD Storage)

  • Huge HDD capacity (up to 336 TB)
  • Use: Hadoop, HDFS, data lakes

🔸 P-Family (GPU Training)

  • NVIDIA V100/A100/H100 GPUs
  • Use: Deep learning, LLM training

🔸 G-Family (GPU Graphics)

  • Cheaper GPUs
  • Use: Video rendering, 3D, game streaming, ML inference

🔸 Inf / Trn (AWS Custom Chips)

  • Inf = Inference; Trn = Training
  • Use: Cost-effective ML workloads

🔸 Graviton (ARM — "g" suffix)

  • AWS's ARM chip, 40% better price/performance
  • Use: Cost optimization for recompiled apps

🔴 TOPIC 3: PRICING MODELS

📋 What to Learn

ModelDiscountCommitmentInterruption
On-Demand0%NoneNo
Reserved Standard72%1 or 3 yrNo
Reserved Convertible54%1 or 3 yrNo
Compute Savings Plan66%1 or 3 yrNo
EC2 Instance Savings Plan72%1 or 3 yrNo
Spot90%NoneYes (2-min warning)
Dedicated HostCostlyOptionalNo
Dedicated InstanceCostlyNoneNo
Capacity Reservation0%NoneNo

📖 Content

🔸 On-Demand

  • Pay per use, no commitment
  • Use: Short-term, unpredictable

🔸 Reserved Instance (RI) — Standard

  • Commit 1 or 3 years, 72% off
  • Use: 24/7 production (DBs, AD, API servers)

🔸 Reserved Instance — Convertible

  • Can change family/OS/tenancy later
  • Use: Long commitment with architectural flexibility

🔸 Compute Savings Plan

  • Commit $/hr across EC2 + Lambda + Fargate
  • Flexible across regions/families
  • Use: Multi-service workloads

🔸 EC2 Instance Savings Plan

  • Commit to specific family in specific region
  • Flexible on size, AZ, OS
  • Use: Known family, variable size

🔸 Spot

  • Up to 90% off, can be interrupted
  • Use: Batch jobs, ML training, CI/CD, big data
  • NEVER: Production DBs, stateful apps

🔸 Dedicated Host

  • Entire physical server
  • See sockets/cores for BYOL licenses
  • Use: Oracle, SQL Server, Windows BYOL

🔸 Dedicated Instance

  • Hardware isolated but no socket visibility
  • Use: Isolation for compliance (no license concern)

🔸 Capacity Reservation

  • Uses KMS
